properties.evidence: The capability IS the rule third leg. The rule says every issue a field report names gets a root-cause pass and every idea a brainstorm pass; this detector is what notices when a report was registered and nothing recorded that reading it produced anything. A DesignRule rather than a Requirement is the honest target here — SATISFIES is deliberately wildcard-from-and-to for exactly this, and inventing a Requirement so the edge could point at one would be manufacturing intent to satisfy a detector.
